chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the man who has a slave girl whom he has sexual relations with, is it permissible for him to marry her daughter? He said: No. It is like the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And your step-daughters who are in your guardianship'.
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the daughter of his own slave concubine according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the prohibition of marrying a slave girl's daughter by analogizing her to a step-daughter (rubā'ib) based on the Quranic verse in Surah An-Nisa. This ruling highlights the juristic principle that the sexual consummation with a slave creates a mahram relationship akin to marriage, thereby extending the Quranic prohibition of step-daughters to include the daughters of one's own concubine.
